name: PortraitCallouts
job: Show one person (owner, chef, founder) with fine lines drawn from the portrait to short facts around it, such as years in trade, favourite tool and signature piece (twist: a personal introduction in one glance, like an annotated figure)
visitor_action: hover or tap a callout to enlarge it; others quiet down
mobile: callouts stack under the portrait and lines shorten to ticks
motion: leader lines draw outward from the portrait once, labels fade in (reduced-motion: lines and labels shown at once)
provenance: original, built from a concept description
art_direction: Field guide: sage-green paper, sepia ink lines and small serif labels, brass number dots, matte print texture
notes: Leader anchors sit at fixed spots on the photo, so on some crops a dot can land on the face; lines only show at 720px+ container width (ticks below that).
